sections.title: Sound of sha
paragraphs: The letter name is (ша) /ʃa/. It makes the sound in (школа) /ˈʂko.ɫə/, which means school. This letter makes two sounds in Russian speech.

sections.title: How to say sha
paragraphs: Curl your tongue tip slightly back behind your top teeth. Leave a small gap and blow air out. A fricative is a consonant where air makes a hiss. Do not use your voice. Touch your throat to feel that it does not shake. For the voiced sound, turn your voice on. You can feel your throat shake.

sections.title: Spelling of sha
paragraphs: This letter usually makes its voiceless sound, as in (шар) /ʂar/. It becomes voiced before a voiced consonant, as in (наш дом) /naʐ dom/. That sound change happens smoothly between the two words.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not say this letter like the soft sound in English ship. Pull your tongue tip back and make the hiss lower and darker. Never lift the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth.
